errors.evidence: The description claims the 'Final Acc' line is stable around 0.88–0.90, but the values in the plot fluctuate more widely, between approximately 0.86 and 0.93.

This description of the 'Δ Acc' line is incorrect. The line does not decline steadily from an initial confidence of 0.97; it remains relatively flat between 0.97 (value ~0.87) and 0.98 (value ~0.87) before dropping sharply to ~0.76 at 0.99.
The line style for 'Initial Acc' is described as 'dotted', but the legend and the plot clearly show it is a dash-dot line.
